about_the_game:
THIS GAME IS VERY EARLY IN PRODUCTION

MUST FIND BEANS is a fast-paced first person shooter set following the realization that you’re all out of beans. The problem is, you’re nearing the end of cooking all the other items and you can’t just not have them. Without beans, the day just won’t be started off right.

Many will try to stop you as you race out in search of the final piece of your meal. But you must not let them. Find a can of beans by any means necessary before everything else you began cooking burns.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of cartoon violence within the context of a fictionalised setting.
